items.name: Academy courses (Survival basics, 7 modules)
items.license: Written for this project, from public-domain US government manuals
items.note: Based on US Army field manuals (FM 21-76, FM 3-25.26, FM 3-05.70), FEMA/Ready.gov, CDC and Red Cross public guidance. Each lesson names its source. Not medical or legal advice.

items.name: Academy course: Map reading and land navigation (5 modules, 41 lessons)
items.license: Written for this project, from public-domain US government manuals
items.note: Based on the whole of Army FM 3-25.26 (Map Reading and Land Navigation; military-only parts left out), FM 21-76, USGS map symbol guidance and NOAA magnetic field information. Each lesson names its source.

items.name: Academy course: Casualty care in a crisis (5 modules, 20 lessons)
items.license: Written for this project in our own words from public guidance
items.note: Based on the published Committee on Tactical Combat Casualty Care (CoTCCC) guidelines, Stop the Bleed (American College of Surgeons), the HHS CHEMM START triage algorithm, FEMA CERT Basic Training (public domain) and American Red Cross first aid guidance. Nothing is copied from any training school's course. No medicine doses. It does not replace a hands-on class.

items.name: Skills cards, drills and lessons added 2026-11-07 (navigation, water, group skills)
items.license: Written for this project in our own words from public guidance
items.note: 13 skills cards (resection, grid references, contour lines, night movement, solar water disinfection, pre-filters, water planning, silent signals, rally points, reporting, group movement, estimating distance, map orientation), 10 drills (23 to 32) and 6 added Academy lessons in the Survival basics course. Paraphrased from the US Army Ranger Handbook (SH 21-76) and Army land navigation manual (FM 3-25.26), both US government works, plus CDC, EPA, WHO/Eawag and Ready.gov guidance. No medicine doses. DRAFTS until a qualified person has read them.

items.name: Academy course: Protective driving (2 modules, 6 lessons)
items.license: Written for this project in our own words from public guidance
items.note: Based on NHTSA and AAA public driving, winter and flood-safety guidance and public police and FBI personal-safety advice. Nothing is copied from any training school's course. It does not replace a hands-on class.

items.name: Academy course: Noticing surveillance (2 modules, 6 lessons)
items.license: Written for this project in our own words from public guidance
items.note: Based on public awareness-level guidance (Cooper colour codes), FBI and police personal-safety and crime-prevention advice and FTC privacy guidance. For personal safety only. Nothing is copied from any training school's course. It does not replace a hands-on class.

items.name: Academy course: Home and residential security (2 modules, 6 lessons)
items.license: Written for this project in our own words from public guidance
items.note: Based on DHS/CISA, US Fire Administration, Ready.gov and police crime-prevention guidance. Nothing is copied from any training school's course. It does not replace a hands-on class.

items.name: Academy course: Safe and accurate shooting (2 modules, 6 lessons)
items.license: Written for this project in our own words from public guidance
items.note: Based on the universal firearm safety rules (NRA, NSSF, Project ChildSafe) and public marksmanship fundamentals. Laws differ by place; check yours. It does not replace a certified instructor. Nothing is copied from any training school's course. It does not replace a hands-on class.

items.name: Academy course: Family medical care without a clinic (5 modules, 15 lessons)
items.license: Written for this project in our own words from public guidance
items.note: Based on American Academy of Pediatrics HealthyChildren.org, CDC, ACOG patient guidance, American Red Cross, National Institute on Aging (NIH), American Heart Association, SAMHSA 988, ASPCA Animal Poison Control and AVMA guidance. Nothing is copied from any training school's course. No medicine doses: it says what a medicine is for, the dangers and when to see a doctor. DRAFTS until a qualified reviewer signs them off; it does not replace a doctor or a hands-on class.

items.name: Academy course: Building your stash (5 modules, 15 lessons)
items.license: Written for this project in our own words from public guidance
items.note: Based on Ready.gov / FEMA, CDC and EPA guidance on making water safe, CDC pool chemical safety, USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service, US university extension guidance on long-term food storage, CPSC and NFPA safety guidance and the USGS National Map. Prompted by a video of hardware-store items; nothing is copied from it, and its unsafe claims (food-unsafe buckets, tape on chest wounds, cord stitches) are corrected. No prices, no medicine doses.
